settings.system_prompt_description: Sets an extra system prompt for this conversation, applied on top of the assistant's system prompt. Leave empty or clear to use the assistant default.
settings.cwd_description: Pick the working directory (cwd) for this conversation inside the workspace.

empty_state.select_description: Pick a conversation from the sidebar to view messages
empty_state.no_message_description: This conversation does not have any messages yet

conversations.jump_target_missing: The target message no longer exists

compress.title: Compress conversation history
compress.description: The current chat model writes a structured summary of the conversation so far and adds it at the end.
compress.additional_prompt_hint: What to keep or focus on
compress.keep_recent_desc: These messages are not compressed and stay after the summary. 0 compresses everything and reuses the prompt cache best; if the conversation is too long to compress, keep more messages.
compress.background_hint: Compression runs on the phone in the background and continues if you close this page. Messages sent meanwhile are queued and sent when it finishes.
compress.running_from_app: The app is compressing this conversation's history…
compress.running_hint: Messages sent meanwhile are queued and sent when it finishes; regenerate is unavailable until then.
compress.wait: Compressing history. Try again when it finishes.
compress.error_busy: The conversation is generating, waiting for approval or has queued messages. Try compressing later.
compress.error_already: This conversation is already being compressed
compress.error_changed: The conversation changed during compression; nothing was saved. Please retry.
compress.checkpoint_info: It uses the same request as the chat, so the prompt cache is reused. Earlier messages stay visible but are no longer sent to the model; delete the summary to undo.
compress.error_nothing: No new messages to compress since the last summary
compress.error_not_enough: Not enough messages to compress. Reduce the number of messages to keep.
compress.error_pending_tools: Handle the pending tool calls before compressing
compress.error_tool_call: The model tried to call a tool instead of writing the summary. Please try again.
compress.error_cli: A CLI chat is compacted by the CLI itself: send /compact
compress.review_ready: Summary ready. Review it before it is used.
compress.review_desc: Edit the summary if needed. It is inserted only when you apply it; discarding leaves the history unchanged.
compress.estimate_exact: Usage before is measured by the provider; the rest is estimated locally.
compress.estimate_local: All figures are local estimates; the system prompt and tools are not counted.
compress.error_request_limit: Chunked compression exceeded the max request limit. Increase the limit or compress a smaller range.
compress.error_timeout: Compression request timed out. Retry or increase the per-request timeout.
compress.from_original_desc: Ignore earlier checkpoints and compress from the very first message; bypasses prompt cache.
compress.carry_over_budget: Carried messages plus kept recent messages exceed the target budget. Reduce items or remove some.
compress.carry_skipped_budget: Skipped {{count}} earlier message(s) automatically to stay within budget.
compress.carry_empty: No user messages available to carry in this range.
compress.carry_edit_desc: Edits only the copy written into the checkpoint; the original message stays untouched.
compress.estimate_chunked: Too long for one request; will use standalone chunked compression (~{{count}} chunks, limit {{limit}}; bypasses chat prompt cache).
compress.estimate_chunk_limit_warn: Estimated {{count}} chunks exceeds the max request limit of {{limit}}; compression may stop early.
compress.estimate_cache_bypassed: This run uses a standalone request and will not hit the chat's prompt cache.
compress.new_conversation_hint: Keeps this conversation intact and opens a new chat with the summary and kept messages.

context_records.title: Context records
context_records.description: Compression and clear-context checkpoints in this conversation. Undo a checkpoint to restore the full history behind it.
context_records.empty: No compression or clear-context records yet.
context_records.cleared_hint: Previous messages are kept on screen only and omitted from model requests.
context_records.revoke_later_message: {{count}} newer record(s) exist after this checkpoint. Undoing only this one may leave context gaps.
context_records.clear_confirm_message: Inserts a clear-context marker at the end of the chat. Messages stay visible, but won't be sent to the model. You can undo this anytime in Context Records.

context_usage.title: Context usage breakdown
context_usage.note: Total uses provider usage when available; per-category breakdown and draft are local estimates totaling {{estimated}}.

stale.edit_message: This message is covered by {{count}} later compression or clear record(s). Without undoing them, the model will keep seeing the old summary or cleared state.
stale.delete_message: This message is covered by {{count}} later compression or clear record(s). Existing summaries will not automatically rewrite after deleting.

cli.readonly_hint: Switch or configure CLI sessions in the App

size_warning.title: This conversation is very large
size_warning.detail: {{nodes}} messages; the last request sent about {{tokens}} input tokens. Consider compressing the history or starting a new conversation.

conversations.tavern_off: This chat has a character, but SillyTavern mode is off for this assistant, so the character card is not sent.
